comment: Hand-set EMC values. generate.py copies 'items' into pack/config/ProjectE/custom_emc.json and 'fluids' (EMC per 1000 mB) into fluid_emc/fluids.json, then adds what it generates. Everything else is derived by ProjectE and the Prestige mod's GT recipe mapper.

groups.why: ProjectE's own default values for vanilla items GT's recipe changes leave ProjectE unable to value (its bucket and metal-block recipes need tools or machines): bucket = 3 iron, lava bucket = bucket + redstone, block = 9 ingots.
The Transmutation Tablet is free: the Prestige mod hands it out, so burning or sweeping it must yield nothing.

GT's own stones, which generate in the world and come out of the Rock Breaker: marble and red granite at ProjectE's value for vanilla granite, diorite and andesite (16), cobblestone forms included (a forge hammer and a furnace turn one into the other). GT's concrete blocks set from concrete fluid (made from water and stone dust) at a nominal 1.

Vanilla items you can obtain but no recipe makes (mob drops, loot, silk-touched blocks), so ProjectE has no value for them. Priced like ProjectE prices their neighbours, and kept under the 100 EMC exploit threshold where a farm can make them (totems from raid farms, trial keys from trial spawners). Owner decisions, listed in the #55 report.

GT blocks made in the world rather than by a recipe: construction foam sprayed from a can (made from water and stone dust) and what it hardens into, at a nominal 1; brittle charcoal from a charcoal pile, below the charcoal it drops.

Nether star (owner decision 5, #59): the wither skeleton skull is priced by rarity (wither skeletons spawn only on Nether fortress pieces, which overlap 1 in 8 Nether Run areas, and drop a skull 2.5% of the time: about 8,192), the nether star at its ingredient cost, 3 skulls + 4 soul sand (49 each, ProjectE), so the automatable Wither loop gains nothing. Overrides ProjectE's c:nether_stars default (139,264).

ProjectE defaults a GT recipe undercuts (#59): GT synthesises blaze powder from carbon and sulfur (about 147 EMC) and its compressor packs 4 powder into a rod, so ProjectE's 1,536 rod gained about 1,000 EMC per rod. The rod is worth the 4 powder it is pressed from.

Steel stays 288 and wrought iron 256 (#55): the primitive blast furnace makes steel from an iron or wrought iron ingot and nearly free coke or charcoal (257 EMC), or a block from a block and 2 charcoal blocks, so at 512 every ingot gained 255 EMC; and v0.3.0's mapper would otherwise lower both to the share a gaining decomposition (a tool head of a floored material) gives them.

fluids_comment: Water is the one free fluid (ADR-0005). Lava is ProjectE's default lava bucket (832) minus the empty bucket (768). Steam is nominal (boilers make it from water; no recipe values it). GT fuels are hand-set (#41). Milk is ProjectE's milk bucket (784) minus the empty bucket. Every other fluid is generated.

pin_at_derived_value.why: Items the game can't derive although this model can, pinned at the value the model derives. A recipe cycle that subtracts a byproduct fluid on every pass (5 magnesite -> 2 magnesia + CO2, 2 magnesia + CO2 -> 5 magnesite): ProjectE floors on every pass, so in the game their value sinks to 1-2 EMC, and magnesia then electrolyses into 512-EMC magnesium. The facade cover: GT crafts it with a special recipe class that ProjectE skips.

floors.why: Late-tier floors (owner decision 3, #59): minimum EMC for the dust and ingot of each tier's new materials, tuned with prestiges_per_tier.py so every tier takes 5-10 Prestiges and each tier's kit costs more than the last: EV titanium (2,048, the rarity price of its rutile; the bauxite chain otherwise makes rutile so cheap that the titanium EV hull undercuts the stainless HV hull); IV tungsten; LuV ruthenium, rhodium, indium and HSS-E; ZPM europium, trinium and naquadah alloy; UV the fusion products (americium, darmstadtium, duranium, naquadria, tritanium, neutronium). Only materials no ore yields directly, so the floors raise kit costs without raising what a Run's ores are worth. Products derive upward; the gain from making a floored material (a fusion output worth more than its inputs) is intended, at its own tier.

tags.why: ProjectE's tag defaults that would still value the tag node above the item that now has a new value (#59): c:nether_stars (owner decision 5) and c:rods/blaze, pinned at the item's value. (generate.py also pins the metal and gem tags whose ProjectE defaults it overrides.)

accepted_exploits.why: Recipes ProjectE reports gaining 100+ EMC that pricing doesn't fix, accepted with a reason; scripts/smoke-test.sh exempts recipes whose output is listed here (and those making a floored material).

outputs.gtceu:diesel: Blending 1 heavy fuel + 5 light fuel into 6 diesel gains about 270 EMC (ratio 1.55): diesel is hand-set at 768 (#41) while the refinery derives light and heavy fuel from oil (256). Fixing it means re-pricing GT's fuel chain (#41, power generation #25), not this ticket.
outputs.gtceu:iron_plasma: GT's fusion reactor (LuV) makes iron plasma from silicon and magnesium. Iron keeps ProjectE's default (256 per ingot; an earlier rule, trades and the Philosopher's Stone rely on it), and silicon is cheap (sand), so fusing them gains about 700 EMC per run; iron plasma is worth its molten iron so cooling it gains nothing.
